mapper.select: select id, card_id, user_id, direction, state, step, stability, difficulty, next_review_date, last_review_date, reps, lapses, last_rating, first_learned_date, mastered_at, updated_at from pw_card_progress where user_id = #{userId} and card_id = #{cardId} order by direction asc for update

select cp.card_id from pw_card_progress cp inner join pw_card c on c.id = cp.card_id where cp.user_id = #{userId} and c.deleted = 0
and ( lower(c.side_a) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') or lower(c.side_b) like concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%') )
group by cp.card_id having count(distinct case when cp.mastered_at is not null then cp.direction end) = 2 order by max(cp.mastered_at) desc, cp.card_id desc
mapper.update: update pw_card_progress set state = #{state}, step = #{step}, stability = #{stability}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, next_review_date = #{nextReviewDate}, last_review_date = #{lastReviewDate}, reps = #{reps}, lapses = #{lapses}, last_rating = #{lastRating}, first_learned_date = #{firstLearnedDate}, mastered_at = #{masteredAt} where user_id = #{userId} and card_id = #{cardId} and direction = #{direction}
mapper.delete: delete from pw_card_progress cp using pw_card c where c.id = cp.card_id and c.deck_id = #{deckId}
